title: EU Artificial Intelligence Act Regulation (EU) 2024/1689
publisher: Official Journal of the European Union
supports_claim: Classifies recruitment and candidate screening AI systems as High-Risk AI systems under Annex III
limitations: Applies specifically to European Union deployment context and markets

title: Amazon Scraps Secret AI Recruiting Tool That Showed Bias Against Women
supports_claim: Demonstrates machine learning resume scoring models penalizing female applicants due to historical male-dominated hiring data
limitations: Case study based on internal trial data from technical hiring datasets

title: Select Issues: Assessing Adverse Impact in AI Used in Employment Selection
supports_claim: Establishes regulatory guidelines on algorithmic adverse impact and Title VII non-discrimination compliance in hiring
limitations: Focuses primarily on United States federal employment law frameworks

title: Law on Personal Data Protection No. 91/2025/QH15
supports_claim: Vietnam Law 91/2025/QH15 (effective 1 Jan 2026) requires organisations to obtain explicit consent before processing personal data including automated profiling that influences employment decisions; supersedes Decree 13/2023/ND-CP which applied from July 2023 to December 2025
limitations: Implementing decrees under the 2025 law are still being issued; specific enforcement precedents for AI-based hiring tools have not yet been published by Vietnamese authorities; does not define high-risk AI categories with the specificity of EU AI Act Annex III
